title: Mint Condition
lines: Coulson slides a binder across the counter. Nine pockets, every card sleeved.
COULSON: 1991 Impel. Near-complete. Don't tell the Director I brought these on assignment.
COULSON: This one's Cap. I was eight cards short of the set when the Battle of New York happened.
COULSON: You work with these people every day. You know what that's worth?
He lets you hold the binder. He watches your hands the entire time.
Your bond with Agent Coulson has deepened.

title: The Tower Keeps Its Own Hours
lines: Jarvis polishes the same glass for the third time. It was already clean.
JARVIS: I served Mr. Stark's father, you know. This tower has burned down twice.
JARVIS: Heroes rebuild buildings. Someone has to rebuild the mornings after.
JARVIS: You keep this team fed and moving. That makes two of us, I suppose.
Your bond with Edwin Jarvis has deepened.

title: Quiet Floor
lines: The training floor is dark. Hulk sits against the wall, taking up most of it.
HULK: ...You keep coming back. Even after Hulk broke the weight machine.
HULK: Banner says tower people are scared of Hulk. You don't smell scared.
HULK: ...Hulk likes the quiet floor. Don't tell metal man.
Your bond with Hulk has deepened.

title: The Quiet Floor
lines: He is waiting by the lift when you come up, which he has never done. Somebody has folded a jacket over one arm. It is enormous, and it is the only thing he brought.
HULK: "Banner packed. Banner packs when he thinks we are leaving."
HULK: "Hulk told him we are not leaving. Hulk told him this is the quiet floor now."
He looks at the jacket for a while, the way you look at an argument you have already won.
HULK: "You go out. Things hit you. Then you come back and you are smaller." A pause. "Hulk comes too. Hulk is not smaller."
Hulk joins the team.
